thread:
leah: Starting promotion for auth-service chart v1.8.0 to prod (us-east). Canary going to eu/1a. Fingers crossed.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed -> PASS (liveness/readiness ok). Post-canary: image digest mismatch detected between chart values and registry. rule: image-pinning-required.
mike: Wait, the chart values have image.tag=1.8.0 but image.digest is empty. Our policy requires pinned digest for prod. Did the build pipeline forget to inject digest?

leah: CI artifact shows publish step failed to annotate digest in index.yaml due to transient registry timeout. Promotion script skipped digest check (bug).

release-lead: Change window til 03:30 UTC. Options: 1) Pause promotion and inject digest into values then resume. 2) Rollback canary and re-run full pipeline. 3) Continue without pin (not allowed by policy). Recommend 1 to minimize customer impact.

ops-oncall: Note: new image has a small auth timeout tweak. Watch auth request latency while we patch.

mike: Agreed with option 1. We can fetch digest from registry and set values.image.digest to sha256:<digest>. Command: kubectl -n prod set image deployment/auth-service auth-service=registry/repo/auth:1.8.0@sha256:<digest> OR use helm upgrade --reuse-values --set image.digest=sha256:<digest>. Helm path is preferable to keep release history.

leah: Pausing promotion now. deploy-bot: action queued: promotion: pause by leah at 3467901240.

mike: I'll query registry for immutable digest. Running: curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json" https://registry/repo/auth/manifests/1.8.0 | jq -r .config.digest -> sha256:abc123def456...

mike: Applying helm upgrade: helm upgrade auth-service payments/auth-chart-1.8.0.tgz --namespace prod --reuse-values --set image.digest=sha256:abc123def456 --timeout 5m

deploy-bot: Helm upgrade performed, release revision bumped. Rolling update started for canary pods.

ops-oncall: Observing auth latency metric: slight spike during pod restarts, now trending back to baseline. No 5xxs.

deploy-bot: Post-patch checks: image digest present in release values, policy check passed. Canary healthy.

release-lead: Good. Resume promotion but add a soft guard: next waves will run preflight CI to verify digest present before promoting. Create INF-1432 to fix promotion script to fail fast on missing digest.

leah: Resuming promotion (wave 2) at 3467901260. deploy-bot: Wave 2 -> starting (us-east-1b).

deploy-bot: Wave 2 -> PASS. Post-checks clear. No auth latency regression.

mike: I'll open PR to CI: add step to check chart index.yaml and artifact metadata contains image.digest for all prod tags.

release-lead: Release notes blurb: "auth-service v1.8.0: image digest is now pinned. Promotion paused briefly to inject missing digest due to registry timeout during publish; no user-facing errors observed. INF-1432 opened to prevent recurrence." Link: https://go/release-notes/auth/1.8.0-draft

leah: Assignments: leah -> create promotion incident INF-1432 with timeline; mike -> CI PR for digest check; ops-oncall -> monitor auth metrics for 24h.

deploy-bot: promotion complete. artifacts: helm-chart auth-1.8.0.tgz, promotion-log: https://go/promote/3467901234/log

leah: Thanks team, closing thread once INF-1432 is filed.
